intent.zh: 客户端左下角账号卡此前显示会话 username（RBAC uid，如 dingtalk:.../employee-a），不是员工真实姓名，也没有登录方式标识。登录 payload 已带 user.display_name；本变更把 display_name 与会话内登录方式（local/wecom/dingtalk）带到渲染层，账号卡显示真实姓名，并在姓名前显示企业微信/钉钉品牌图标（本地登录仍用首字母头像）。
intent.en: The bottom-left account row showed the session username (RBAC uid such as dingtalk:.../employee-a) instead of the employee's real name, and had no login-provider badge. Carry display_name and the login method (local/wecom/dingtalk) through the session and render the real name with a WeCom/DingTalk icon before it (local logins keep the initial avatar).

acceptance.criterion: 扫码登录 done 的 user.display_name 进入 Session.displayName；QR 会话 provider=wecom/dingtalk；auth/state 下发 displayName/provider
acceptance.command: corepack yarn workspace @zeokeel/dsh-enterprise vitest run tests/auth-gate-qr-login.spec.ts tests/auth-gate-login.spec.ts tests/audit-r15b-password-and-identity.spec.ts

acceptance.criterion: 会话映射覆盖 display_name/provider；不改变 sessionIdentity（余额归属仍按 serverURL+username）
acceptance.command: corepack yarn workspace @zeokeel/dsh-gateway-client vitest run tests/gateway-client.spec.ts

acceptance.criterion: 账号卡显示 displayName 而不是 username；wecom/dingtalk 在名字前显示品牌图标，缺失时回退首字母
231 本地客户端顶部会话显示「钉钉图标 + 员工姓名」；构建与类型检查通过
acceptance.command: corepack yarn workspace dsh-plugin-desktop build + Xvfb 运行客户端截图

risk: 旧会话文件没有 displayName/provider，升级后会显示 username/首字母；重新登录一次即恢复。provider 只由宿主在登录时写入（local/wecom/dingtalk），不从不可信网关字段透传。
rollback: 回滚本提交并重新打包客户端；服务端 userJSON 未改，回滚不影响登录。
